positions.commentary: Meta used to hire only from top schools like Stanford, MIT, and Harvard, but that role is gone and they no longer require degrees from those specific institutions.
Google now formally does not take college degrees into account and will equally rank candidates regardless of whether they have a degree.

thesis: The episode argues that the traditional higher education model is facing a crisis, noting that major tech companies like Meta and Google have shifted away from requiring degrees from top institutions. Consequently, the value proposition of elite universities for career placement in these specific sectors is diminishing.
